title: Conjuration Ritual Spell
description: Phinis Gestor requires a Sigil Stone from Oblivion to inscribe Master Conjuration spells. Summon and subdue an Unbound Dremora on the roof of the Hall of Attainment to retrieve one, then deliver it to Phinis for the Flame Thrall spell.

base_facts: Expert Conjuration instructor at the College of Winterhold.
Can teach Master-level Conjuration spells once given a Sigil Stone.

QUEST_STARTED: Has given the player the Summon Unbound Dremora spell to retrieve a Sigil Stone.
SIGIL_STONE_OBTAINED: Is waiting for the player to deliver the Sigil Stone.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Has rewarded the player with the Flame Thrall spell tome and can now sell Frost Thrall, Storm Thrall, and Dead Thrall.
Quest complete. Phinis has given the Flame Thrall spell and unlocked Master Conjuration spells for purchase.

After he is dead you must summon him in the circle again, and he will speak again: "I am not your plaything, worm!" At this point another two dialogue options will appear: At this time he will become hostile and you.
Talk to Phinis Gestor and receive your reward of the Master Conjuration Spell, Flame Thrall.

beats.comment: Quest begins when Phinis gives the Summon Unbound Dremora spell after reaching 90 Conjuration.
Player has subdued the Unbound Dremora multiple times and obtained the Sigil Stone.
Player delivers the Sigil Stone to Phinis to complete the quest.
Quest complete. Phinis has given the Flame Thrall spell and unlocked Master Conjuration spells for purchase.
